lines_pipelines.label: Oil pipelines (flow status)
lines_pipelines.plain: Mapped oil pipelines, coloured by the documented status of the oil block each one serves. Proposed routes are shown too, but they were never built.

points_crisis_sites.label: Protection sites and displacement camps
points_crisis_sites.plain: UN Protection of Civilians sites, camps for displaced people and refugee camps, with changes in status over time. For example, several PoC sites became IDP camps in 2020-21. The list is not complete.

points_fmr_monitoring.label: IOM travel monitoring points
points_fmr_monitoring.plain: Places where IOM staff count people on the move, shown for the months each was active. Flow-monitoring numbers depend on where these points are.

points_health.label: Health facilities (registry status over time)
points_health.plain: Hospitals and clinics with their registry status in each period. The status comes from comparing the 2016, 2019-20, 2023 and 2024 facility lists and adding documented closures. Being on a list does not prove a facility was working.

points_insecurity_insight.label: Attacks on aid, health and education
points_insecurity_insight.plain: Reported incidents against aid workers, health care and schools, and conflict-related sexual violence, 2018-2025. Dots sit at state centres, not where the incident happened.

points_logcluster_hubs.label: Aid logistics hubs and warehouses
points_logcluster_hubs.plain: Humanitarian logistics hubs and shared storage sites on UN Logistics Cluster maps, 2018-2026. Each is placed at its town, not at the exact warehouse.

points_markets.label: Markets with WFP price monitoring
points_markets.plain: Markets where the World Food Programme records food and fuel prices, shown for the months each reported. The price layers come from these markets.

points_oil.label: Oil fields and wells (production status)
points_oil.plain: Oil fields and mapped wells, coloured by the documented production status of their oil block. This includes the 2018-19 restarts, the 2024 export halt and the December 2025 Heglig disruption.

points_schools.label: Schools (status over time)
points_schools.plain: Schools with their status from the 2015 and 2019 school lists, the 2019-20 village assessment and the 2020-21 COVID-19 closure. There is no school-level data after May 2021, so later statuses are carried forward.

points_ucdp_events.label: Deadly conflict events (UCDP)
points_ucdp_events.plain: Violent events that killed at least one person, 2018-2025, from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program, with the estimated number of deaths.

points_unmiss.label: UN peacekeeping bases
points_unmiss.plain: UN peacekeeping (UNMISS) bases and team sites over time, with approximate troop numbers and base closures.

points_water_points.label: Water points (last known status)
points_water_points.plain: Boreholes, wells and taps recorded in water-point surveys, mostly before 2018. Each shows the last reported working status, which may be out of date.

polygons_ethnic_groups.label: Ethnic group areas and political power (EPR)
polygons_ethnic_groups.plain: Where ten major ethnic groups live and how much national political power each held in each year, as coded by the Ethnic Power Relations dataset up to 2023. The 2023 status is carried forward to later years.

points_gbv_one_stop_centres.label: Gender-based violence (GBV) one-stop centres
points_gbv_one_stop_centres.plain: Hospital centres where survivors of sexual and gender-based violence can get medical care, counselling, and legal and police help in one place, plus three safe houses. Each is shown from the first report that it was working. UNFPA reported 13 centres every year up to 2024 but named only a few after 2020 (Juba in 2023, Wau up to early 2025, Malakal and Bentiu in early 2025). For these centres a hollow marker means no source has confirmed the centre since it was last mentioned. It does not mean the centre closed.

points_oil_pollution.label: Oil spills and pollution reports
points_oil_pollution.plain: Two documented oil pipeline spills north of Bentiu in 2019, and two located reports of contaminated water and flooded wells in the Unity oil fields.

points_oil_wells_flooding.label: Flood water around oil wells (radar)
points_oil_wells_flooding.plain: Mapped oil wells where satellite radar saw open flood water around the well in each period. This shows flooding, not contamination, and it misses water under vegetation.

points_surface_water_quality.label: River and wetland water colour (satellite)
points_surface_water_quality.plain: Monthly satellite readings of how muddy the water is at eight river and wetland sites, compared with the usual level for that month. This tracks sediment and algae; it cannot detect oil or chemical pollution.

points_disasters.label: Natural disasters (floods, droughts, heatwaves)
points_disasters.plain: Floods, drought alerts and heatwaves reported in 2018-2025, one dot per affected county (or one for the whole country) for as long as the event lasted. Flood figures are people affected, as counted by the UN. Each dot sits at the county centre, not at the flooded place.
